title: Replay tick-loop duplicated (test vs harness)
evidence: record_run (test) and run_demo (harness) each reimplement the apply-tick-N-before-step-N loop, the per-tick state_hash call, and the event drain/clear.
detail: Pinned §11.1 convention implemented twice; divergence risk if it evolves.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared core proc (e.g. run_ticks(state, ticks) -> []u64) both call.
